notes.title: Act III is now available
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png

We're happy to announce that Act III of the game is finally available!
Download the free DLC at this link!

With the Act III update will be added this functionality:

    Added 2 hours of gameplay.
    Added 9 new playable game screens.
    Added 7 new interactable characters.
    Proofreading of all the game texts.


To play Act III is mandatory to download the free DLC and to complete Act II.

Have fun!

notes.title: Act II is now available
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png

We're happy to announce that Act II of the game is finally available!
Download the free DLC at this link!

With the Act II update will be added this functionality:

    6 to 9 hours of gameplay.
    19 new playable game screens.
    26 new interactable characters.
    A complete French text translation.
    The full OST.
    Some minor fixes.


To play Act II is mandatory to download the free DLC and to complete Act I.
If you already completed Act I it could be necessary to complete it again to play Act II, due to a previous bug.

Have fun!

notes.title: Patch #3 - Version 1.0.0
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png

Hello fellow gamers,
here a new important update for the game!

Fixes:

 Changed the Alchemy Set minigame.
 Changed the Eco-Engine minigame.
 Proofreading of all the game texts (English and Italian).
 Added three more OST tracks.
 Some minor fixes.


Coming soon:

 The other few missing tracks to complete the OST for the Act I.
 The free DLC for the Act II.
 Act II trailer.


Cheers and keep having fun!

New Patch - Version 0.9.92
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png

Hello fellow gamers,
here we are with another update for the game!

Fixes:

 Mac support added.
 Some typo corrections.
 Some game menu minor fixes.
 Added a confirmation window when skipping the alchemic minigame.
 The mouse pointer will now be hidden during dialogues with no options (you still have to click to go forward in the dialogue).


Coming soon:

 New OST tracks to complete the full OST of the game.


Cheers, keep having fun, and happy new year!

notes.title: First Patch - Version 0.9.91
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27166411/c9ddaf311a85b0f42636926e860e770d970d0cdc.png

Hello fellow gamers,
here we are with the first small update: it has been reported to us that in the English version of the game, in the alchemic minigame, some text wasn't visible; moreover some sound effect were played always at full volume. 

We just fixed it! ːTerrySmileː

Fixes:

 The English alchemic minigame now correctly show the result text.
 All the sound fx of the game are now played at the correct volume.


Coming soon:

 A confirmation window when skipping the alchemic minigame.
 New OST tracks to complete the full OST of the game.


Cheers and keep having fun!
